name: DI+
description: This keyword returns the value of the positive directional movement indicator line. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the value of the positive directional movement indicator line. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632142631.png)

The above condition is checking if the Previous day(-1) DMI positive value is greater than the previous to previous day value (-2) for Nifty 50

The  average directional index  (ADX) is used to determine when the price is trending strongly. The ADX makes use of a positive (+DI) and negative (-DI) directional indicator in addition to the trendline.

Read more about ADX here - https://www.investopedia.com/articles/trading/07/adx-trend-indicator.asp
